description: This is a FastAPI route module implementing authentication endpoints including register, login, get current user, update user, and token refresh functionalities. It defines API routes, handles user creation and login logic, and interacts with the database via repository classes.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest = Body(..., description="Registration payload"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Registers a new user, ensuring email and username are unique, hashes password, and returns minimal user info.

methods.name: login_user( login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Authenticates user by email and password, returning a mock JWT token and user info.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the profile info of the current trusted user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the profile of the current trusted user.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Provides a new access token for the current trusted user (mock).
